messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a controlled regional route shift: move ~15% of user traffic from eu-edge -> apac-edge. Target window: 2026-09-12 02:00Z UTC. Who will execute the routing change? Need: deploy owner, smoke test owner, rollback path, and TTL lowered to 20s at 01:30Z. CC @noah @priya

noah: I can run the deploy. I'll be on-call that window. Plan:
- Canary 1% for 10m
- If green -> 5% for 15m
- Then 15% steady
Abort criteria: >1% error rate increase or 95th latency +50% vs baseline. I'll post preflight at 01:45Z.

priya: I'll own smoke. Quick checklist:
- run synthetic across eu/apac
- check traces for error spikes
- verify token/rate-limiter paths
- confirm logs show no 5xx
Commands I will run:
```bash
curl -sS 'https://api.redwood.internal/health?route=eu' | jq .status
for r in /generate /chat; do curl -sS -i -X POST https://api.redwood.internal${r} -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | head -n 10; done
```
I'll start smoke at 01:55Z and report.

juan: I can handle DNS quick-revert. Can we reduce the Edge route TTL to 20s at 01:30Z? Current infra TTL is 300s. Lowering now requires a cert window; if ops approves I can schedule the change in Terraform at 01:10Z and apply at 01:30Z.

maya: yes please lower to 20s. Add the playbook link in the deploy message: https://redwood.example/runbook/edge-shift

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment by @noah at 2026-09-12T02:00:00Z (canary 1% -> 5% -> 15%).

noah: preflight done @01:50Z — service baselines: 95p=280ms, error=0.12%. Proceeding to execute canary at 02:00Z.

priya: smoke started at 02:01Z — synthetic hits OK, no 5xx, traces look normal. CPU on apac edge stable.

noah: canary 1% in place @02:05Z. Observing metrics.

noah: minor 95p bump to 360ms at 02:12Z on a subset of requests. Pausing progression and holding at 1% while we investigate.

priya: checking traces — saw a retry loop from a downstream CDN for ~30s, appears transient. No 5xx. I recommend hold 1% for another 10m.

juan: standing by to revert DNS immediately if we decide to abort; TTL already 20s so revert should propagate quickly.

noah: ok holding 1%. Will re-evaluate at 02:22Z.

priya: after 02:20Z metrics normalized. 95p back to 290ms, error stable. I give the green to proceed to 5%.

noah: increasing to 5% @02:27Z.

deploy-bot: traffic moved to 5% — monitoring window started (15m).

priya: smoke at 5% passed. No regression on critical traces.

noah: rolling out to 15% @02:45Z. Will watch for 30m before finishing.

deploy-bot: traffic at 15%.

maya: thanks team. After 30m, if metrics stable we'll close and document notes in the runbook. I'll file a short post-run note with the tweaks.

noah: rollout complete; metrics green. Leaving a short debrief in #eng-postmortems tomorrow.

priya: confirmed — smoke checks final: PASS :tada:

juan: reverting TTL back to 300s at 03:30Z.

noah: thanks everyone. Good teamwork. :thumbsup:
